config.classes_note: Three classes, each the census's own kind, unit or intersection for the entity, stated by field sources at the loci given: (1) occupational exposure to generative AI, the census's kind and evidence_kind ('exposure estimate'; B1, B9 Abstract, B4); (2) task-level automation potential, the census's unit and method (B9 §2, B2, B4); (3) the employment effects of AI, the census's intersection 'gains-and-losses' (B9 §2 and Conclusion, B5). The archive's instruments of labor direction (the Directionality of Semantic Labor, #771, and its canonical surface #1392; the directionality stack; user labor drag) and its semantic-labor line bear on performed work, the interaction in which a system's labor advances or departs from a commissioned task; the census's lv_intersection places the entity against them ('it meets task-origin only as a prior on which tasks are exposed. It observes no performed work, so it cannot speak to whether a system's labor advanced a commissioned task, or to user labor drag'). They enter A only where a sentence applies them to the entity or to one of the three classes; DSL's own vocabulary (task-advancing, commissioned task) is not a class the field sources for the entity, and is not searched as one.
